title: Masters of Scale picks Incorruptible for its 2026 Summer Reading List
summary: Masters of Scale — Reid Hoffman's podcast network spanning Masters of Scale, Rapid Response, and Pioneers of AI — names Incorruptible to its 2026 Summer Reading List of 11 books, alongside Arthur Brooks, Maya Shankar, David Epstein, Lew Frankfort, Nicholas Thompson, Joanna Stern, Carrie Joy Grimes, Vivian Tu, Jacob Soboroff, and Danny Funt.
blockquote: When mission-driven companies lose their way, it's rarely bad actors — it's bad structure. Eric Ries makes the case for designing governance that protects a company's purpose from the gravitational pull of success, drawing on decades advising founders.
